import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text } from 'react-native'

export function Keyboard() {
    return (<View style={{
        width: 300,
        height: 300,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)',
        borderRadius: 20,
        borderWidth: 3,
        borderColor: '#356',
        position: 'absolute',
    }} >

        <View>

            <View style={{flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center'}}>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>1834</Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>Apagar</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={{
                flexDirection: 'row',
                justifyContent: 'space-around',
                alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>1</Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>2</Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>3</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={{
                flexDirection: 'row',
                justifyContent: 'space-around',
                alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>4</Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>5</Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>6</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={{
                flexDirection: 'row',
                justifyContent: 'space-around',
                alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>7</Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>8</Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>9</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={{
                flexDirection: 'row',
                justifyContent: 'space-around',
                alignItems: 'center',
                marginHorizontal: 25
            }}>
                <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                    <Text style={{
                        fontSize: 20,
                        color: '#fff',
                        backgroundColor: '#17A2B7',
                        position: 'absolute',
                        padding: 5,
                        borderRadius: 5
                    }}>Cancelar</Text>
                </View>


                <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>0</Text>

                <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                    <Text style={{
                        fontSize: 20,
                        color: '#fff',
                        backgroundColor: '#26A744',
                        position: 'absolute',
                        padding: 5,
                        borderRadius: 5
                    }}>Concluir</Text></View>
            </View>

        </View>
    </View >
    )
}
